meta.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements

copy.tagline_en: Request code review before merging to ensure requirements are met

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会派一个专门的代码审查助手，审查你最近的代码改动并给出反馈，如修复建议、改进点。
howto.when: 当你完成子任务、实现主要功能或准备合并代码时触发审查。遇到困难或重构前也可使用。

say.text: 请为我刚完成的Task 2做代码审查。
say.note: Claude会审查该任务相关代码。

say.text: 帮我审查当前分支的代码改动。
say.note: Claude会对比最近提交并反馈。

say.text: 我在修复复杂bug后有点困惑，请审查一下。
say.note: Claude提供新鲜视角。等待原文。2s左

howto.what_en: Claude dispatches a dedicated code reviewer subagent to examine your recent code changes and provide feedback like fixes and improvements, keeping the reviewer focused on the work product.
howto.when_en: Trigger review after completing a subagent task, finishing a major feature, or before merging to main. Also useful when stuck or before refactoring.

say_en.text: Review the code changes on this branch.
I'm stuck after fixing a complex bug, please review.
